authorization: 2026-10-31 user approved preserving existing conditions and supplementing E1, recording protocol first, and preparing slide 8 results.
question: Do predefined gait feature families add predictive information beyond the existing speed family for actual TUG/SPPB?
scope: Exploratory follow-up on repeatedly analyzed development data. This is not preregistration before the original discovery results, independent confirmation, causal analysis, measurement-accuracy validation or clinical validation.
inputs_and_groups: Reuse the exact frozen input.npz, metadata.json groups/features, people, visits, targets and source linkage from the parent experiment. No new extraction, subjects, clinical endpoints or target-based exclusions. OpenCap STS and turn/chair features are not in these frozen inputs; do not infer results for them.
split: Exact stored three person-5fold assignments, seeds17/41/89. Reuse stored fold ledgers and outer RF seeds9000+100*repeat+fold. No tuning or reselection.

model.name: RF
model.preprocessing: Parent train-only median imputation plus missing indicators and StandardScaler; retain all-missing columns; no output clipping or rounding.

comparisons.addition: For EVERY existing non-speed family X: RF(speed+X) minus RF(speed). The speed family is exactly the original family, including its existing summaries and missingness indicators, not a newly selected scalar.
comparisons.removal: For EVERY family X including speed: RF(all-X) minus RF(all). Positive values indicate worse predictions after removal. This is supporting evidence of nonredundant information, not a required gate for addition evidence.
comparisons.all_vs_speed: RF(all) minus RF(speed), descriptive combined-input contrast.
comparisons.reuse: Reuse exact saved fixed-candidate outer predictions wherever present. New fits are only shuffled controls and deterministic verification replays. Do not change parent files.

shuffle_control.design: For each speed+X comparison, shuffle ALL raw columns of X as one block across people, separately within the outer training set and held-out test set, preserving each block's within-row relationships and NaNs. Keep speed, IDs, targets, RF seed and train/test membership fixed. Apply imputation/scaling only after shuffling and fit on outer training people only.
shuffle_control.rng: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([shuffle_seed,dataset_index,repeat,fold,family_index,partition]); dataset order matches primary_datasets+supporting_datasets; partition0=train,1=test; indices follow frozen metadata order.
shuffle_control.aggregation: Average ABSOLUTE ERRORS across the five shuffled fits and three repeats within person. Do not ensemble predictions before measuring error. Compare real speed+X error minus this average shuffled-control error.
shuffle_control.interpretation: A negative control for extra feature count/disrupted person linkage. Five seeds are sensitivity checks, not an exact permutation test; block shuffling also disrupts speed-X dependence. Do not claim a causal or conditional-independence result.

metrics.primary: Equal-person MAE in original score points or seconds; first compute per-person absolute errors, average three repeats, then average people. Repeat MAEs are separately reported; repeats share people and are not independent cohorts.
metrics.uncertainty: 10000 paired person bootstrap draws, seed20261031, percentile95 intervals of per-person repeat-averaged error differences. Paired bootstrap uses identical resampled person indices across candidates/controls within dataset. Conditional on fitted models and observed cohort; not full retraining or new-site uncertainty.
metrics.repeat_direction: Number of the three repeat-level MAE differences in the improvement direction, plus all five individual shuffle-seed contrasts. No selective omission.

judgment.additional_information: Use the phrase exploratory evidence of additional information only if (1) addition delta<0 and its95 upper bound<0, (2) addition delta<0 in at least2/3 repeats, (3) real-minus-mean-shuffled delta<0 and its95 upper bound<0, and (4) real MAE is lower than shuffled MAE in at least4/5 seeds (each averaged over repeats).
judgment.inconclusive: If any gate fails, say additional information not established by this comparison; this is not equivalence or proof of no useful information.
judgment.removal_support: Report nonredundant removal support only if removal delta>0, its95 lower bound>0 and removal delta>0 in at least2/3 repeats.
judgment.multiplicity: Intervals are unadjusted and families/endpoints are multiple exploratory comparisons. No confirmatory significance claim or winner selection from these held-out results. Publish every planned comparison.

verification: Before execution freeze hashes of protocol, parent protocol/preparation, all input/metadata files and all90 prediction/ledger/complete triplets. Verify stored people/target/fold coverage for every reused prediction. Refit speed/full and one addition per dataset in repeat0/fold0 using independent sklearn Pipeline construction and compare to saved predictions within1e-9. Independently reconstruct at least one shuffled block/fit per dataset and reload a saved control model for prediction equality. Independently recompute all MAEs, contrasts,10000-draw intervals and decision gates from saved predictions. Check protocol/source hashes unchanged at completion. Inspect final figure visually and check slide text/table numbers.

resources.device: local CPU only; no GPU or network
resources.estimated_additional_storage: under150MB including compressed control predictions and one representative serialized model per dataset; no full forest archive
resources.concurrency: at most2 independent fits, each RF uses2 threads

deliverables: all planned group-addition/removal tables with10000-draw intervals, repeat direction and shuffle contrasts
source/protocol hashes and fresh verification JSON
slide8-ready Korean text/table and static figure; update the existing storyline slide8 only
presentation_limits: Distinguish weekly sensor summaries from short multi-camera OpenCap kinematics and full-trial Vicon measurements. Never merge the larger weekly-summary cohorts with the earlier2174/1939-person bout experiments or interpret between-dataset MAE differences as modality/duration effects. Keep turn evidence separate from walking-only E1.
